rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something matters or is important.

example.english: This matter is very important to me.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 deoi3 ngo5 hou2 gan2 jiu3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a matter that is an issue, concern, or problem.

example.english: We can't put off this matter any longer.
example.traditional: 呢件問題唔可以再拖喇。
example.jyutping: nei1 gin6 man6 tai4 m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 to1 laa3

rows.note: Use this noun when matter means the degree to which something is important.

example.english: This report emphasizes the matter of education's importance.
example.traditional: 呢份報告強調咗教育嘅重要性。
example.jyutping: nei1 fan6 bou3 gou3 koeng4 diu6 zo2 gaau3 juk6 ge3 zung6 jiu3 sing3

rows.note: Use this for a physical substance or a kind of material, especially in scientific or technical contexts.

example.english: Water is a kind of matter.
example.jyutping: seoi2 hai6 jat1 zung2 mat6 zat1

rows.note: Use this for something such as a book or magazine taken or used for reading.

example.english: This magazine is reading matter for my train rides.
example.traditional: 呢本雜誌係我搭車時嘅讀物。
example.jyutping: nei1 bun2 zaap6 zi3 hai6 ngo5 daap3 ce1 si4 ge3 duk6 mat6
